plastic_bottle: Empty it and put the cap back on.
pizza_box: Greasy boxes go in the green cart. Clean lid tops can be recycled.
plastic_bag: Not curbside. Return to a store drop-off bin.
glass_jar: Rinse and leave the lid off.
battery: Never in any cart. Use household hazardous waste drop-off.
coffee_cup: Plastic-lined cups are not recyclable here.
